active.help: If the active field is set to false, it will allow you to hide the case without removing it.

last_stage_id.help: Stage of the applicant before being in the current stage. Used for lost cases analysis.

medium_id.help: This displays how the applicant has reached out, e.g. via Email, LinkedIn, Website, etc.

salary_expected_extra.help: Salary Expected by Applicant, extra advantages

salary_proposed_extra.help: Salary Proposed by the Organisation, extra advantages

availability.help: The date at which the applicant will be available to start working

address_id.help: Select the location where the applicant will work. Addresses listed here are defined on the company's contact information.

alias_id.help: Email alias for this job position. New emails will automatically create new applicants for this job position.

date_from.help: Is set, update candidates availability once hired for that specific mission.

interviewer_ids.help: The Interviewers set on the job position can see all Applicants in it. They have access to the information, the attachments, the meeting management and they can refuse him. You don't need to have Recruitment rights to be set as an interviewer.

new_application_count.help: Number of applications that are new in the flow (typically at first step of the flow)

no_of_hired_employee.help: Number of hired employees for this job position during recruitment phase.

user_id.help: The Recruiter will be the default value for all Applicants Recruiter's field in this job position. The Recruiter is automatically added to all meetings with the Applicant.

email.help: Applications received from this Email won't be linked to a contact.There will be no email address set on the Applicant either.

regex.help: The regex facilitates to extract information from the subject or body of the received email to autopopulate the Applicant's name field

fold.help: This stage is folded in the kanban view when there are no records in that stage to display.

hired_stage.help: If checked, this stage is used to determine the hire date of an applicant

template_id.help: If set, a message is posted on the applicant using the template when the applicant is set to the stage.
